card.name: Word starts that continue into longer words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word or name that is split across pieces, such as "olig" before "uria", "K" in Kanne, "Ar" in Aragon or arabinoside. It is strongest on "olig" in the infant warning about hypotension, oliguria and hyperkalemia.
